g.text: The host process builds a ChatServer, a client process builds a
ChatClient; both are handed to the same ChatForm through
IChatService. That is why the two wireframes are identical apart
from New / Delete: only HostForm exposes room management.
Events arrive from a background read loop, so every handler uses
are disabled while a Task is in flight to stop double sends.
Since v1.1 an entry is a headline over its content, so a picture
is recorded by the character span it was written into: the click
knows only the text at the caret, and two photos from one sender
in one minute have identical headlines.
Every window grew a constructor with no arguments, because the
Windows Forms designer builds a class in order to draw it. Each
one asks DesignTime whether it is being drawn or being used:
while drawn it gets a fake chat, loopback and no history file;
anywhere else it throws. The program still cannot build a window
a double click on a photo's span
a stand-in chat, only while drawn
